changes.summary: Refresh agent guidance for SDK ownership, API migration coverage, delegation, code navigation, and generated template review; no runtime or public API change.

Harden the itf testing framework: Suite.MountAll mirrors the production route table, TestEnvironment.CommitTx/FreshTx formalize committed-seed scopes with rollback isolation, rollback-scope transactions gain a fail-fast concurrency guard (repo.GuardedTx / repo.ErrTxInUse), and i18n assertions (RequireMessage, MessageResolves) catch dot-path and partial-translation traps.
Continue OIDC authorization with the active browser account without showing the account picker.
Align the OIDC browser check with active-account handoff and pass the theme storage key into browser evaluations; test-only changes.

Resolve the theme switcher's 'system' choice against the OS color scheme with a live matchMedia listener shared by the app and the login page, restore the login theme-toggle icons Tailwind v4 never scaled up, and turn the counterparty legal-form select into a radio group with an unchanged form contract.
Exercise the visible login theme toggle labels in browser checks; test-only change.
Build Lens compatibility assets before full-suite mounted controller tests.
